authority: Integrator owns canonical types, SQL and assembly. No source file modified by framing.
scope: Reuse attributed evidence from existing occurrences, not a qualified-conclusion registry or decision-memory replacement.
proposedMinimalContract: ReleasedResearchScope: server company/run, admitted public profiles/watches, resolved entities, versioned freshness policy, execution mode.
ResearchEvidence: existing EvidenceRef and SourceEvidence plus first/last observed and source_observation_only qualification.
ResearchReadSet: scope token, exact refs, freshness policy version, read time and valid-until; emitted by server for run.
ResearchLookupResult: found/empty/partial/error, reusable evidence, exclusions and read-set.
ResearchRefreshResult: durable operation/occurrence identity, explicit uncertain state and observed external-call count.
proposedPorts: refreshResearch({readSet, reason, operationKey}) with server admission and public query construction
versionRules: Use exact refs plus scope/profile/entity generation, not global company generation. Empty lookup and new contradicting evidence must be covered.
Identical recollection does not change generation. Temporal expiry and freshness-policy version remain separate currentness checks.
Define accepted correction ordering rather than selecting maximum publishedAt; existing evidence storage has no current-version pointer.
Server records dependencies actually released to the run. Model cannot remove dependencies from proposal.
Runner checks before/after provider/tool/prepare. Server repeats under publication transaction and approval locks.
Use compatible lock order: company, research scope, case, run/proposal.
Correction makes dependent evidence require review and pending plans stale; historical approved decisions stay historical.
refreshProposal: For first slice prefer durable refresh, then stale_context and a new run on released versions. Continuing in the same run requires dropping old evaluations/proposal/batch and old model messages, rebuilding context, and current case/business checks. Replacing a token alone is unsafe.
qualificationRules: Valid extraction/hash does not make a semantic claim or company link verified.
Last-seen freshness does not change publication, event or statistical period.
Missing publication remains unknown. Latest failed collection stays visible and does not silently replace a last successful proof.
Freshness policy and correction authority must be explicitly received.
acceptanceRequirements: R1: persist via data path, close session/clients, new session/run with no old answer/summary in initial context, lookup obtains native refs/hash from database. Repeat after restart without reseed.
Negative control: isolated database lacks proof, same test yields explicit missing result.
R2: changed source same identity, preserve v1, link v2, revise current retrieval and dependent case/plan. Identical v2 no extra version.
Race tests during provider, after evaluation, before publish and before approve.
Foreign company, homonym, missing/stale/partial/error/uncertain and crash after external intent.
Count model and search separately; no claimed gain without measured baseline.

concreteBlocker.detail: Existing evidence boundary refuses mode other than direct. Controlled scenario is mode:test. Require an explicit isolated test path for dependent plan testing; never label fictional source direct for PASS.

openDecisions: Evidence memory scope accepted, without qualified-conclusion claims.
Versioned freshness policy and correction authority.
Refresh terminal/new run vs full reset in same run.
Explicit research result/success without business proposal; generic needs_input alone misdescribes a completed reuse.
coverage: agent/data/product research proposals and selected tests
limits: Cadrage proposed, no canonical contract publication.
No R1/R2 reception and no final code review.
No writes, services, secrets or delegated sub-review.
